events.title: v0.15: Clearer Skills, More Precise QTEs, and Smoother Combat
events.summary: v0.15: Clearer, More Precise, and More Satisfying Combat This update improves how every decision feels in combat: choosing a skill, hitting a target, keeping a streak alive, or moving into a new phase. Based on feedback from the community and creators who played BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya, v0.15 focuses on three goals: making upgrades easier to understand, making QTEs more consistent, and strengthening visual combat feedback. How to join Request access through the Steam Playtest button on the game's store page. Access will be granted to a small first group.
